proposal.status: PROPOSED FOR DISCUSSION — not adopted and not an implementation
proposal.principle: One user-authored recursive screen-format grammar and authoritative address tree, inherited down to UI internals; site holons may own distinct content and subdivisions.
proposal.geometry: For logical long and short viewport axes L,S, a single-cell address at depth n occupies L/2^n by S/2^n; declared multi-cell fields may span cells. Use the same logical assignment under the existing 90-degree portrait projection.
proposal.occupancy: Explicitly distinguish occupied, intentionally open and intentionally layered areas; check complete tiling only where a partition has been declared. No automatic redistribution of undeclared remainders.
proposal.typography: The existing 1rem × 2^(r/2) rank and grid's 2^(-n) subdivision share a factor: r=-2n gives 2^(-n). A strict shared physical unit would require an explicitly chosen grid-derived reference length U; changing from rem changes the scaling behavior and is an unresolved design choice.
migration: Inventory all current layout authorities and preserve authored roles and assignments.
Represent nested UI fields, their relationships, and explicitly intended open or layered regions in one recursive format.
Replace dynamic fit-based address selection and independent CSS geometry with projection from declared fields.
Specify common type origin, ranks and overflow behavior without silently changing layout for content fit.
Witness declared versus rendered geometry, orientation, hit targets, text, occupancy and accessibility on varied viewports and site holons.
proposal.scope: The proposal covers screen-space composition. The 3D world has its own tetrahedral coordinates and projection; whether world coordinates should share this UI address grammar is not decided.
proposal.geometric_constraint: A square visual cannot completely fill an allocated non-square rectangle while preserving its square shape; explicit division, empty space, cropping or distortion must be chosen rather than invented.

changed_scope: Planning evidence only. No site layout, style, runtime or declared grid is changed.
